_about: v62: the act family and the goal of the parere's main line by the client's posture (src/rag/posture.py), read from intake's rito, role and stage. An entry matches when the cell's rito, role and stage are each among its lists. A cell no entry matches -- civile/attore/pre_filing above all -- keeps today's plan exactly (no act, the plan's own goal). The texts are Code's drafts, listed in docs/copy_review.md for the PO. v64: sanctions, the general-part articles on the penalty an imputato's parere applies (each an «applicazione» paragraph in the norms section when it touches the client or a fact of the case). v70: an imputato entry before the sentence carries «subordinate» -- the riti alternativi and the sentencing lines posture.apply_plan adds to the plan's subordinate line, so it exists even when the model does not think of it (Code's drafts). v71: an imputato entry carries «fallback_main» -- the main line when every thesis of the method plan is barred (each contests an element the record marks integrato): the PO's words.
